text: Hello, welcome back to my class, today we will move on to critical thinking, classifying and evaluating.By the end of this lesson, you are expected to collect the health tips in this unit and sort them into different types.Evaluate the feasibility of the health tips based on your condition.Analyze and assess the scientificity and credibility of previous group works.Now, please get your textbook and worksheet ready.Dear students, we are now close to the end of this unit, so it's necessary for us to have an overall review of what we have learned.In reading A, we knew about how to take charge of health in several aspects.In vocabulary section, we applied the vocabulary to the guidelines for a healthy lifestyle.In listening and viewing, we had a glimpse of super-agers and found out the secret to long life.In reading B, we looked into some classic health debates and learned about better health choices.With so much information in this unit, how can we keep it in mind?In fact, by reorganizing the information in a logical way that won't be hard.Just as what you have learned in previous units, a mind map or a diagram will be helpful to sort through.Let's begin with reviewing and classifying all the health tips in this unit.When you classify things, you sort them into groups or types, so that things with similar features are in the same group.In reading A, you sorted the health tips into groups of diet, exercise, and so on.Today, let's expand the table by filling in more information.You have three minutes.Let's see what you've got.In terms of diet, what we should do include eating fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and low-fat protein foods.Making half of your plate fruits and vegetables, which means you should eat at least as much fruit and vegetable as meat.In addition, you should choose fresh or frozen fruits and veggies.Drink fat-free or low-fat milk.Eat from smaller plates.And stop eating when you are 80% full.On the other hand, we should avoid foods high in sugar, salt, and unhealthy fats.Avoid processed foods and sugary drinks as well.Don't serve food in family style.Why is family style not good for health?Because that may lead to overeating.At last, don't skip meals.Do you know the reason?Skipping meals may cause eating disorder, which affects your mood and concentration.These tips are from reading A, grammar in use, and viewing section.When it comes to exercise, we know it's ideal that we keep physically active for at least 16 minutes a day, 3 days a week.Remember to do some routine activities, such as cleaning your room or taking out trash.What's more, download fitness apps onto your smartphone or other mobile devices.In addition, try different kinds of group activities.In brief, being physically active means avoiding sitting down or not moving for a long time.This is called a sedentary lifestyle.Why should we avoid sedentary lifestyle?Studies have consistently demonstrated that leading a sedentary lifestyle can contribute to obesity, diabetes, some types of cancer, heart disease, and early death.Just as a proverb goes, rest breeds rest.Let's get active by doing exercise regularly.OK, tips relevant to exercise have been listed here, which are from reading A and reading B.What about interpersonal relationship?Based on reading A and viewing section, we know we should get active and make friends by joining a sports team, a dance club, and so on.Having more lifelong friends is certainly beneficial to health.In other words, we should avoid being lonely or socially isolated from other people.If we are socially isolated, what may happen eventually?As we all know, humans are social beings and want close and meaningful connection.By nature, we strive to belong and to be part of a larger group where we can interact with others.It's the natural order of life.When a person is cut off from others, negative health effects might emerge.These effects can be psychological, physical, or combination of both.In short, the negative effects of social isolation should be avoided.Finally, what are the other tips on healthy living?Well, we were informed that having enough sleep and brushing teeth twice a day, better with an electric toothbrush, do good to health.That is to say, don't stay up late.Don't skip brushing teeth or brush them for less than a minute.So far, we have wrapped up all we learned in this unit.Actually, classifying information like this can help us better remember and apply it.Next, we are going to evaluate these health tips according to your own condition.Among the tips above, which one do you think is the most practical for high school students?By practical, we mean likely to be effective or successful in a real situation.Please share your ideas.You have two minutes to
